services.name: Peggy’s Cove at Sunset
services.desc: We pick up you and your group early in the afternoon for a unique evening experience visiting this renowned lighthouse and the majestic landscape of Peggy’s Cove. At this time of day, we have the area almost all to ourselves to explore with your local guide who is a local professional photographer. They will share photo insights tailored to your needs, and reveal our favourite vantage points to help you improve your travel photography. quotes.text: What a fabulous experience that will salways tay with me! Geordie, our group leader, is a great communicator and was able to convey his passionate about Sable Island, the ever changing beauty and remoteness along with the rare family history he has with the island (GREAT stories and family album BTW). Picture Perfect Tours provides excellent communication pre/post trip and goes the extra mile through his intuitive marketing practises. Being part of a 'small group' makes for a very intimate adventure with like-minded people. This was a trip like no other - what a very special day!

This was a once in a lifetime opportunity for me and it did not disappoint! The absolute awe - and tears-started the second I saw the beautiful strip of sand ! I was afraid I wouldn't see horses and I could literally see them before we landed. They were majestic in their winter coats. Though I had less interest in the seal, they were so plentiful we saw them lounging, socializing, fighting and going in and out of the ocean. We even saw one that had quite obviously just been born. The guide was an amazing historian. Just overall bliss. I'm still floating.

My dream come true trip to Sable Island was simply perfect. I was terrified of travelling by helicopter but it was unbelievably smooth ( thanks to pilot Dave) I was afraid of not seeing any horses but saw them even before we landed. They were majestic and plentiful. I had little interest in seals but marvelled at their colors, their socialization and even saw a very newly born pup and mom. Geordie our guide was an amazing historian with a passion for this peace of heaven. It was entirely Picture perfect!! ( Horse pic taken with zoom lens)

We had the most wonderful afternoon exploring Peggy’s Cove with Donna from Picture Perfect Tours. Donna was thoughtful, insightful, energetic, and wonderfully engaging, with a gift for bringing the area to life through local stories, history, and details we wouldn’t have discovered on our own. She struck the perfect balance of being knowledgeable while keeping the experience relaxed, personal, and fun. Such a memorable way to experience this beautiful part of Nova Scotia. We couldn’t recommend Picture Perfect Tours more highly!

My wife and I decided it was time to visit Sable island and are so glad we did! Geordie, with his family history on the island, made the trip feel extra special! In the dramatic setting of the dunes and the ocean, the wildness of the horses and the cuteness of the seals, (who don’t get enough credit in my opinion) made for a spectacular day! While it is not an inexpensive adventure, it is absolutely worth every penny! 5+ stars for Geordie and Picture Perfect Tours!
